newsitem.title: CHINA: China nabs man after finding bomb at rail station.
newsitem.headline: China nabs man after finding bomb at rail station.

text.p: Chinese police have arrested a man suspected of planting a bomb in a busy train station powerful enough to destroy the building, the Xian Procuratorial Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Monday.

It said two scavengers stumbled across the home-made bomb on August 5 and alerted the police to 7.95 kg (17.5 lb) of explosives outside the busy railway station in Xian city, home to the famed Qin Dynasty (221-206 BC) terracotta warriors.
Police defused the bomb that could have caused serious damage and casualties within a radius of 100 m (328 ft), or an area of 3.0 hectares (7.4 acres), it said.
